description.en: Creates a generic scripted model instance (a prop, effect, or ball — not a roster character) from a model/motion file and attaches it under a named bone/dummy, returning a handle used with the other CMND_* character functions (CMND_SET_POSRY, CMND_DELETE_CHARA, ...).
Object category/pool index (3 is used for event props/effects in script_clean).
Internal display name for the instance (often Shift-JIS text).
Path to the model/motion-pack file to load, e.g. "data/chr/option/bal00.xc".
Name of the bone/dummy/tag to attach the instance to, e.g. "dmy", "File", "Effect".
Optional flag (meaning varies by object type, e.g. whether to keep the model loaded).

example.code:
// Spawn a ball prop attached to the "File" dummy
local hBall = CMND_CREATE_CHARA(3, "\x0083{\x0081[\x0083\x008b", "data/chr/option/bal00.xc", "File", 2, true);
